description: This file defines the IWriter interface for the PhpSpreadsheet library, outlining methods and constants for writing spreadsheets, including options for charts, formula calculation, disk caching, and saving files.

classes.name: IWriter
classes.description: Interface that specifies methods for writing spreadsheet files, including configuration options and the save method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an IWriter instance with a given Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether charts should be included when writing the spreadsheet.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Sets whether to include charts in the written spreadsheet.

methods.name: getPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Returns whether formulae are pre-calculated before saving.

methods.name: setPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Sets whether to pre-calculate formulae before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Spreadsheet to a file with specified flags.

methods.name: getUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Returns whether disk caching is used when writing.

methods.name: setUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Enables or disables disk caching, with optional cache directory.

methods.name: getDiskCachingDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory used for disk caching.
